'''jedimaster Training to Train 1.3''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[jedimaster]]
* '''Published:''' 26 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 MWYHL jedimaster LS 2003 Training.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Yet another incarnation of my MWYHL/SYIC deck. I took some ideas from Tyrannus' Higher Learning Deck.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

I will be adding all the Def. Shields and a Padme soon. On to strategy...

D.O.S. - use to train

All other characters - deploy after D.O.S. completes Test 5, use them for a beatdown.

ICBW - pretty obvious, used to keep force loss to a minimum early. Best used in conjunction with Jedi Test 1 (can't use It's Worse to add to a drain).

OTE - used in conjunction with the Electrobinculars to retrive while you wait for Test 5 to be completed or you can use it after to keep ahead.

Stone Piles - very nice to slow your opponent down.

Advantage - good way to create a solid 1 Force Loss per turn after the beatdown starts.

Control/Tunnel Vison - used to slow your Force loss early in the game.

Starships - should be enough to keep a hold on the space drain race...might consider adding another HCF.

Rebel Reinforcments - very nice...used to retrive characters..and one goes into your hand!

Any help would be greatly appreciated. One day this deck will be close to tournament ready and I will have all you to thank.
